responsibility: Defines the `check` phase module for `rustc_typeck`, wiring together per-body type-checking infrastructure, shared helper types and utilities, submodule exports, and top-level orchestration hooks used to type-check item bodies and record their results.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the more specialized `mod.rs` files under `check/`, this is the top-level coordinator for the entire type-checking phase, wiring submodules and overall body-checking flow rather than implementing one focused subsystem such as `FnCtxt` state or method lookup.
